typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCatalystNonSMMPalert_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Par Amount} as string,
		{BR Counterparty} as string,
		{Trade Date} as string,
		Trader as string,
		{B/S} as string,
		{Ticket Number} as string,
		{Doc Level} as string,
		Cusip as string,
		Counterparty as string,
		Price as string,
		{Trade Subtype} as string,
		{Import Source} as string,
		SMMPIndicator as string,
		{Settle Date} as string,
		Inventory as string,
		Salesperson as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromvwCatalystNonSMMP
fromvwCatalystNonSMMP sink(input(
		Par_Amount as string,
		BR_Counterparty as string,
		Trade_Date as string,
		Trader as string,
		B_S as string,
		Ticket_Number as string,
		Doc_Level as string,
		Cusip as string,
		Counterparty as string,
		Price as string,
		Trade_Subtype as string,
		Import_Source as string,
		SMMPIndicator as string,
		Settle_Date as string,
		Inventory as string,
		Salesperson as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Par_Amount = {Par Amount},
		BR_Counterparty = {BR Counterparty},
		Trade_Date = {Trade Date},
		Trader,
		B_S = {B/S},
		Ticket_Number = {Ticket Number},
		Doc_Level = {Doc Level},
		Cusip,
		Counterparty,
		Price,
		Trade_Subtype = {Trade Subtype},
		Import_Source = {Import Source},
		SMMPIndicator,
		Settle_Date = {Settle Date},
		Inventory,
		Salesperson),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCatalystNonSMMPalert_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCatalystNonSMMPalert
